blocks.text:
Breakfast and departure heading north of the department. Just 30 minutes away, there is a winery with history and tradition, Bodega Spinoglio. The experience of visiting this winery will surely be unique for your senses.
An exceptional environment where you can connect with nature, enjoying the surroundings with vineyards and more than 6000 square meters of park.
You can visit the 19th-century winery, which today is enhanced by the contribution of technology to produce high-end wines.
Underground, the impressive cellar with its robust stone walls houses old oak barrels with the seal of the famous cooperage Adolphe Fruhinsholz from Nancy, with unique dimensions in Uruguay.
The proposal is to enjoy the overall experience of this land of wines, its parks, the diversity of flora, and the landscape in general.
A didactic tour of the vineyard, the winery, and the century- old cellar is conducted along with a tasting of 4 wines accompanied by cheeses, breads, and a selection by the chef.
Return to the hotel.   
Accommodation in Montevideo.
